The binarization of the image is done by Otsu's thresholding technique due to its success rate and the simplest of calculations involved in this technique. Contour detection helps us to locate the license plate whose coordinates are then compared with the original image. After which the license plate extraction is done followed by segmentation and character classification. The processed information is then sent to an excel sheet which classifies the cars based on the district they are from and is later sent to the concerned department for the necessary action. The information is then sent as an SMS to a mobile number from the excel sheet.

articleTitle: Current Follower based Current Mode Filters
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: An innovative topology to acknowledge a filter based on a current follower is addressed in this research work. The proposed circuit topology utilizes only a single current follower, with two resistors and two capacitors. By changing the components of the circuit, it can realize the filters such as low pass filter, high pass filter, and bandpass filter. The output is available at high impedance node, therefore it can be easily used for cascading of the circuits as it does not cause any loading effect. The presented topology is substantiated by simulation studies using 0.18μm CMOS technology parameters.

articleTitle: Data Auditing in Cloud Storage using Smart Contract
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In general, Cloud storage is considered as a distributed model. Here, the data is usually stored on remote servers to properly maintain, back up and make it accessible to clients over a network, whenever required. Cloud storage providers keep the data and processes to oversee it on capacity servers based on secure virtualization methods. A security framework is proposed for auditing the cloud data, which makes use of the proposed blockchain technology. This ensures to efficiently maintain the data integrity. The blockchain structure inspects the mutation of operational information and thereby ensures the data security. Usually, the data auditing scheme is widely used in a Third Party Auditor (TPA), which is a centralized entity that the client is forced to trust, even if the credibility is not guaranteed. To avoid the participation of TPA, a decentralised scheme is suggested, where it uses a smart contract for auditing the cloud data. The working of smart contracts is based on blockchain. Ethereum is used to deploy a smart contract thereby eliminating the need of a foreign source in the data auditing process.

articleTitle: Harmonics Estimation of a Standalone PV System Integrated with a Modified SPWM Inverter
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This paper has briefly described the standalone photo voltaic system integrated with a modified pulse width modulated inverter. Different types of inverter can be integrated with the PV system. But harmonics are the most disturbances developed in the output of the inverter. This integrated model is designed by the MATLAB Simulink. Finally total harmonics Distortion is determined using FFT tools available in Power GUI block from SIM power system.

articleTitle: Monitoring and Detection of Heat Stress of Layers in Poultry Farm using Multiple Linear Regression
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Environmental change has a major impact on the performance of a poultry farm. Due to high temperature and high relative humidity, the humidex value will increase at an unprecedented rate. Later, this leads to heat stress in layer poultry farm. In such situation, the data is collected using an IoT device for which the Multiple Linear Regression algorithm is formulated to predict the heat stress level in the poultry farm. The accuracy of the model is determined using Root Mean Squared Error, R-Square and Adjusted R-Square methods. The results show that as the humidex value increases, heat stress in poultry farm increases by affecting the overall performance of the layers in a poultry farm.

articleTitle: Pattern Design of Knit and Purl based on CAD System of Automatic Knitting Machine based on Computer Vision Integration
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Pattern design of knit and purl based on CAD system of automatic knitting machine based on computer vision integration is studied in this paper. Through the computer knitting machine CAD and knitting experiment, summed up the system is a different combination of needle and needle anti the law and its application in pattern design, so as to avoid the actual knitting machine. And the design of the original deviation, flower pattern deformation etc. in some unnecessary extent, and for design of knitted apparel provide more experience to reference. Besides this, the machine vision technologies are combined to then achieve the automatic analysis. The experiment results have then validated the effectiveness.

articleTitle: A Differentiation Approach for Robust PID Controller for a Linear BLDC Motor
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The proposed research work intends to present a design methodology for obtaining a robust PID/PI controller for interval systems. This research work makes use of Model-Order Reduction (MOR) technique along with Model-Matching approach for attaining the desired controller parameters. The model-matching approach is used to consider a lower-order open-loop transfer function that embodies the desired time-domain / frequency-domain specifications. The primary objective is to make the step response of BLDC motor along with controller in closed-loop that match the open-loop response of the modeled system for the required time-domain characteristics. MOR technique is implemented for the approximation of high-order controller transfer function that has been attained by using a model-matching approach. In the current research paper, the differentiation technique for approximating the higher-order system is adopted along with Kharitonov's theorem for expanding the bounded parameter variation of a Linear BLDC-Motor, which is considered here as a case study.

articleTitle: Analysis and Implementation of DCS in DC-DC Boost Converter for a Robotic System
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The DC servo motor drives are broadly utilized in delivering excessive performance robot packages. In high performance programs, the rate of motor suffer various parameter changes, load disturbance and model uncertainties. So to take care of all the parameters like speed, and the compensation factors that affect the speed of the motor are also analyzed. This is considered as one of the major and testing task. Due to change in load and the offered electric stress, it effects boost converter topologies and thereby reducing the system efficiency. The additional parameters that are being discussed are speed, position control of servomotor and controlling the movement of a robot leg are also discussed. Here, the proposed work involves the implementation of distributed control system (DCS) in DC-DC Converter for a robotic system. The working rule involves the wall following hexapod walking robots. Here, the hexapod robot containing six legs was controlled by means of six separate servomotors. The servo motor works have supported the principles generated through the fuzzy controller. So as to enhance the performance of the robotic movement DCS is usedin the DC-DC boost converters and are placed at the DC servo motor side. The hexapod robot movement analysis is formed using virtual robot experimentation platform (V REP) software. Moreover the open loop response and PID response graphs using DCS is implemented on MATLAB Software. In this studies, the entire process is done on simulation by the use of MATLAB.

articleTitle: An Image Cryptosystem based on Tent Map
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: With the increasing growth of multimedia applications, security has become an important aspect of the transmission of images. Encryption is one form to guarantee safety. Digital images need security in storing and communication and are made use of in numerous domains namely medical systems, audiovisual applications, military etc. Here, an image encryption scheme which is chaotic that provides security is described. Also, the proposed system is enhanced with row and column shuffling. Further, four variants in shuffling are provided based on the coordinates.

articleTitle: Improvement of Throughput using Dual Connectivity in Non-Standalone 5G NR Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Wireless communications are constantly evolving to facilitate better access to information for the improvement of business, education, and technology around the world. Hence to overcome the lack of spectrum new bands like millimeter wave (mmWave) bands are needed to be utilized. The mmWave bands offer a huge spectrum due to which substantial attention is being given to exploit this frequency range for deploying 5G cellular systems. 5G wireless technology is expected to deliver multi-Gbps data rates, vast network capacity, low latency, and more reliability. Despite the provision of the spectrum, the new mmWave bands are prone to blockages and obstacles. Hence, these bands must be deployed with the help of an architecture that can overcome this drawback and can prevent any disruption of service in case of blockage. This paper implements a non-standalone (NSA) architecture using modified dual connectivity of user equipment (UE) to Long Term Evolution (LTE) module and mmWave module of ns-3 for more robust deployment of 5G New Radio (NR) network. It also includes a detailed discussion upon the design and functioning of 5G NR in NSA mode with the help of a simulation setup. Finally, the performance of the 5G network in standalone (SA) and non-standalone modes are compared both graphically and numerically based on the throughput measurements.

articleTitle: Real Time Application of Deep Learning Approach in Exogenous Skin Problem Identification
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The proposed research work provides an easy way to the dermatologists and other medical professionals to acknowledge any given skin problem in a better way. The proposed work based on deep learning algorithm aims to make up the need of dermatologists in India. In the landmass sized country roughly 11,000 derma experts are employed, which means less than one derma experts for 100,000 patients. This work aims to help relieve the circumstances. It can diagnose five types of skin problems like redness. swelling. puss. cold sore. and tinea versicolor. The proposed system assure the patients with an option to self-check their signs or symptoms like redness swelling etc that makes this work a real time application. The patient can also then associate to a dermatologist online for consultation within a momentary span of time by unloading their photos to hospital website, and dermatologists give guidance by analyzing the photos with faster R-CNN deep learning algorithm. The system uses tensorflow object detection framework with faster RCNN configuration for skin problem like redness, pus and swelling assessment and successfully estimates these skin problem depending on maximum scores from the trained model. The main aim of this system is to achieve maximum accuracy of dermatological problem prediction.

articleTitle: TSDLA: Algorithm for Location Privacy in Clustered LB-MCS network
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In Location Based (LB)-Mobile crowd sensing (MCS) network, the user in order to carry out the task on behalf of the task provider has to provide his personal details like id, location, account details and so on mandatorily. In case if the task provider is malicious, he may track the user using the location and carry out any attack. In order to provide untraceability the location of the user has to be protected. Currently anonymization is used to provide dummy locations to the user and protect the user from this attack. The dynamic nature of users helps the malicious users to gain an edge over the dummy location set of authorized users to act as them. In order to enhance the privacy preserving mechanism a Time Synchronized Dummy Location Allocation (TSDLA) based on K-Means Clustering Algorithm (K-MCA) is proposed. A proper surrendering mechanism is designed so that when the user's multiple location transmission is been handled more efficiently. Using k-means clustering algorithm to enhance the performance in the presence of large number of users in the network. The privacy preservation is evaluated by the performance metrics like entropy, threshold, and cost benefit analysis.

articleTitle: Eye Tracking as a form of Alternate and Augmentative Communication for people with Speech, Language and Communication Needs
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Diagnosing a disease or a condition has become easy and convenient for the clinician, in this digital era. However, the focus on rehabilitative medicine and recovery oriented technology is not as popular as diagnostics. The current trends in eye-tracking involve the tracking of the progression of cognitive disorders in the elderly patients. The tracking of eye motion can give deterministic data about the patient's ability to focus, socially interact, track moving objects (muscle movement), and so on. With the help of eye-tracking, the proposed system helps in designing an efficient system for alternative and augmentative communication (AAC), by utilizing a camera and a screen (with visual prompt display) to determine the accuracy, and speed of response, to categorize the efficiency of AAC method. The system in design can help to improve the latency of patient response and can help to determine the recovery status of the patient.

articleTitle: Hierarchical clustering based Intelligent Information Retrieval approach
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In this digitalera, there is an enormous increase in the digital documents due to the use of the internet. Despite the hype, in the processing of digital documents, the problem of polysemy interprets more than one meaning for a single word. Hence the polysemy related queries will adversely affect the relevant result retrieval process. The paper addresses the polysemyissue on information retrieval paradigm and used clustering as a tool for improving the accuracy and appropriateness in the information retrieval process. This paper proposed a novel approach that generates a coherent group for the query topic. The proposed model is a hybrid of the k-means algorithm and the hierarchical approach named as HK clustering model to utilize the efficiency of both the strategies and overcome the drawbacks of each other.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Non-Isolated SEPIC Based Buck-Boost Converter Suitable for LVDC Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: DC-DC converters are commonly used for output voltage regulation; converters regulate the overall voltage of the system by increasing or decreasing their output voltage. These inductors and capacitors help in this kind of voltage fine-tuning, which temporarily stores the input energy coming to the DC-DC converters and then discharges it out. This conversion method can increase or decrease the voltage level. In this paper power loss analysis of SEPIC based buck-boost converter and derived non-isolated SEPIC based buck-boost converter is studied, both converters are designed for LVDC (Low Voltage DC) systems. MATLAB model of converters is also included in this paper. The converter implemented in this paper has only one switch so this converter can be easily controlled in continuous conduction mode(CCM). However, the number of storage components increases, power losses as well as the complexity of implementation also increases. The working principle and mathematical analysis of the derived converter is explained here. In conclusion, experimental results are also verified.

articleTitle: Cost Optimization For Intelligent Enterprises Using Modified GWO
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Today digital revolution is playing a vital role in many intelligent enterprises and hence there is a need to manage the applications efficiently with optimal cost and a reduced end to end processing time. In this paper, a novel algorithm “grey wolf optimization for the shortest path (GWOSP)” is devised using the concept of grey wolf optimization. Here the algorithm dynamically determines the short path of a given graph to reduce the overall cost and time. Later a performance evaluation is carried out between GWOSP and Dijkstra's algorithm based on execution times. It is realized that the performance of GWOSP algorithm is better when compared to Dijkstra's algorithm. The proposed methodology can be vastly adapted in cost and risk optimization and it aids towards addressing few challenges of intelligent enterprises.

articleTitle: A Novel hybrid heuristic-metaheuristic Load balancing algorithm for Resource allocationin IaaS-cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Cloud networks have used for secured data processing during the transmission of data to authorized persons. Cloud computing consists of a group of clients that spatially distributed and dedicated to monitoring the external user, managing, and recording information. Load balancing is an important parameter utilized. In this paper, a hybrid heuristic mathematic algorithm (HHMA) has proposed for the IaaS computing network, which solves the resource allocation problem cloud network. To obtain a faster design and reduce the file download time, the cluster divided into small chunks using improved K-means clustering technique (heuristic). Then cockroach swarm optimization (MCSO) algorithm proposed to measure the load ratio of a computed node by different constraints which realize the real-time load. After MCSO algorithm performance, the optimal comprehensive evaluation value is established for assigning the master node to storage node. Optimal processing has been obtained using two algorithms to dedicate the request data to the reasonable nodes. Hence way, resource utilization has achieved high performance and improvement over other techniques. The simulation result shows that the proposed method has reduced the network overhead, average response time, and memory load. As a result, the proposed heuristic scheme is a promising and well-constructed scheme for cloud computing investors.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Impulse Generator circuit using Matlab Simulink
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In this paper, an overview of both single stage and multistage impulse voltage generator is given. This paper consists of the simulation of both single stage and multistage impulse voltage generator by using Matlab Simulink. Simulation is preferred over experimental testing because it makes analysis easier, efficient and free from risk. Attempts are made to evaluate the effect of variation of the charging resistances on the impulse voltage wave with the help of Simulink, an extension of Matlab, to get the standard values of wavefront time and wave tail time. Also the effect of increasing the number of stages on the impulse voltage wave, efficiency and voltage regulation has been observed.

articleTitle: MPPT controlled wind energy conversion system(WECS) supplying DC micro-grid
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Due to popularity and support, especially for wind, the use of renewable energy is increasing. This also enables the generation of electricity without the emission of polluting gasses. Renewable energy resources are used as substitute for fossil fuels in electrical power generation. MPPT tracks the optimal power for the given wind speed and maintains the output constant at maximum power even though the input varies. The trend is moving towards the DC micro-grid, which can supply DC loads at various voltages. The DC voltage is fed into a grid, which can supply various subsystems. By considering various factors, voltage levels of 24/48V suits best for residential and low power application. The battery can also be used to store DC voltage. AC loads can also be supplied using this grid by connecting an inverter to the grid. The renewable energy resources are used as substitutes for fossil fuels in electrical power generation. This P&O MPPT algorithm automatically finds the WECS current and voltage at which it delivers a better voltage. If the output power decreases or increases because of the perturbation, then the perturbation corresponding to it will be in the opposite or same direction. In this on-going and increasing energy demand, many countries have started using renewable sources for power generation and transmission, and distributed grids interconnecting generators. This demonstration is carried out using Matlab/Simulink software.

articleTitle: Test-Driven Development of Automotive Software Functionality
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The growing sophistication of automotive software has made the development of high-quality software a cumbersome process in a small period. There exists a compromise between software complexity, quality, and duration to build it. Software development costs increase as the duration of the life cycle extends. Errors detected late in the life cycle which must have been detected early, such as contradictions in specifications and ambiguities, also raises the life-cycle costs of software development. In this approach, the Test-Driven Development (TDD) process for Automotive Software is discussed, which incorporates agile methods in the early stages of development, dramatically decreasing the possibility of discrepancies and ambiguities in specifications and thereby lowers development costs. TDD is one of the practical approaches for improving the quality and reliability of software. In the proposed methodology the tests are automated, the bugs are recognized and fixed, which in turn reduces the software development life cycle costs and improves software reliability.

articleTitle: Interactive Exploration of Compact Sequence Diagrams - JIVE based approaches
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Sequence diagrams are a popular visualization notation to refine and describe use case scenarios for object oriented application development. They are used to model/specify object-to-object interactions in clear sequence. Tools such as JIVE can be used to re-construct back the scenario from a real program execution in the form of sequence diagram. The sequence diagrams thus obtained tend to be large and hence JIVE provides novel options to compact the visualization structure without distorting the semantics. In this paper, an interactive technique to explore compact sequence diagrams that allows users to expand and examine the compacted portions on demand is presented. At the heart of the technique is the call tree implementation that forms the back-end of the visualization. The call tree is extended to work with the sequence diagram at the front-end in the symbiotic manner enabling interactive exploration. The utility of the technique is demonstrated through experiments with a variety of programs.

articleTitle: A Sophisticated Irrigation System with Passive and Analogue Sensors over Web Using Orange Pi
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Irrigation is supplying the required amount of water artificially to the soil to grow crops especially in arid regions. Re-wetting of soil is done differently for different regions based on the crops grown there. These needs are particularly addressed in our sophisticated irrigation system. The humidity and temperature of the soil are precisely controlled with a remote monitoring system using an Arduino module by collecting data wirelessly to a central server that is Orange Pi which collects the data, stores it and sends it to the user mobile. This system also has a water level passive sensor which will indicate the presence of water level in the tank and the unit triggers the actuators which will fill up the tank automatically with groundwater. Being a solar-powered system, this doesn't have any issue with electricity. The system provides perfectly timed Automated Mixing of Fertilizers and chemicals and spraying on the crops which are perfectly programmed for every seasonal crop that is grown considering pH sensor readings of the soil. Graphs that include Water utilization, profit mapping analysis, utilization of fertilizers have been plotted which prove the efficiency of our sophistication.

articleTitle: Enhanced Security for the authentication of Digital Signature from the key generated by the CSTRNG method
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Security is the most critical feature of the present e-world. Many applications are based on random number generation. In the present situation, it is very difficult to hide the data. So the key-based encryption process is suggested to keep the files secure. The protection of the data depends on the key. Key generation is more important for all cryptography applications, which is entirely dependent on randomness. As long as many designers have been able to develop many Random Number Generator-based keys. Also work is going on to make hacker data more stable. CSTRNG can be suggested in this work. One of the most commonly used technologies in the marketing field is the production of digital signatures. The generation of digital signatures can be generated using many keys that have the property of RNG. The most stable RNG is the Cryptographically Secured True Random Number Generator (CSTRNG). This could generate more unexpected numbers. Work has been built on the Xilinx ISE simulator.

Author Keywords: Cryptographically Secured True Random Number Generator

articleTitle: Highly Scalable Processor Architecture for Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Q-Learning is also referred as a reinforcement learning method. Its main advantage is that of obtaining a near optimal policy while interfacing with an unknown model. This paper presents a hardware architecture for Q-Learning, which is efficient in terms of running a larger set of Q-Learning problem sizes. The proposed research work presents the method and resource utilization, when implemented in FPGA, and algorithm involved in the proposed hardware. The proposed algorithm consumes a negligible area when compared to the parallel implementation of Q learning algorithm.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on Intelligent Formative Evaluation of Text Guiding Performance Assisted by Java System and Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Empirical study on intelligent formative evaluation of English guiding performance assisted by Java system and data mining is conducted in this paper. In MDD, the application is abstracted into the high-level model. Through the interpretation or execution of the model, the abstract model can be then automatically converted into executable software code. Based on this technique background, we introduce the intelligent data mining model to optimize the traditional pipeline. The test on the massive data sets have proven the effectiveness. For the scenario demonstration, we apply the proposed model into the intelligent formative evaluation of English guiding performance with J2EE.

articleTitle: Delay Constrained Communications in a Disaster Site using SDN Framework
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In a disaster scenario, it is important to handle the network requests in a delay bound manner such that the rescue teams and survivors can communicate with the outside world effectively and vice versa. This paper addresses the problem of offering multiple service requirements, one having stringent delay but less bandwidth specifications whereas the other type of service can tolerate higher delay. We handle this problem using the SDN framework leveraging its programmability and centralized control. In our solution, each flow is labeled based on the Type of Service field and the controller decides at every switch the link to follow based on the latest delay information. The controller makes use of Dijkstra's algorithm to obtain a path with the shortest delay and alternate paths as well with higher delays. The path also requires to satisfy the minimum bandwidth requirement as specified by a particular flow. Moreover, SDN is able to handle any dynamic scenarios in the network. If there is a link failure or congestion in any path, SDN is able to modify flow rules and make the flow follow alternate paths. Thus, it is able to offer reliable communications in a disaster scenario.

articleTitle: A Novel Web Service Search System Using WSDL
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The proposed system investigates SOAP based web services. This search system dynamically discovers the web services and integrates the required web services to satisfy the user requests. Using search engine, WSDL files are retrieved and these files are processed to select the required web services. In this system, user requested functional words are searched using search engine. Horizontal, vertical, inter-cluster and intra-cluster searches are performed on these search results. All elements of WSDL files are compared with user given functional word using weight matrix and selected web services are executed to satisfy the user request. Performance of different search systems are analyzed. Due to dynamic nature of web services, stored data set is not used for implementation. Instead WSDL links are retrieved during run time which is novelty of the proposed system.

articleTitle: Implementation of a Novel Self-Cleaning Roof Top PV Cells using Protective Film Coating
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The global energy crisis is pushing countries to develop more policies in the energy sector, especially in the areas of renewable energies, which help the production to move slowly towards a more sustainable environment. One of these forms are photovoltaic solar systems, where the installation is taking a rapid upward drift in the installation, since it is the method of producing light-hearted energy but currently with its minimal efficiency, and also the dust accumulates on the transparent surfaces supported through a sharp drop against the transmission coefficient is one of the foremost challenges faced by the solar systems. The main objective of this work is to obtain a hydrophobic coating against the available synthetic coatings. Consequently, when planning the use of self-cleaning methods in photovoltaic solar systems, it is necessary to carry out a complete planning to obtain the maximum efficiency results by using the quantitative method for the raw numerical data and overall the study was analyzed as a case study.

articleTitle: AAYU APP - Mobile Application for Healthcare Management System
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In the healthcare domain, the mortality rates are increasing unprecedentedly by shifting a critical patient from one hospital to another hospital due to the lack of necessary medical equipment. This arises the need to propose a novel mobile application, which can show the information about different hospitals with necessary equipment in a particular location. This paper has proposed the novel application to mange the information about different hospitals in the nearby localities of the user and also it is developed to provide a basic information about medicines. Further, in the case of emergency situations, the proposed application plays an indispensable role by assisting the user in taking the appropriate first aid measures.

articleTitle: Exploiting Localization Capability and Packet Transfer at Intermediate Nodes for Underwater Sensor Networks using Simulations
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Underwater wireless sensor relies on the vantage point in networking for data transfer to sink, which is being positioned at the top surface. The sensor nodes subjected for data transfer are being affected due to mobility which hinders multi-hop communication. Thus localization of the sensor node to provide measurement and data transfer post deployment varies. Thus subsequent investigation has to be made continuously for routes to enable location coordinates. The purpose of this work is to consider the localization within a sensing area and underlying routes for data transfer associated to sink. Underwater Localization and Packet Transfer (ULPT) has been proposed to estimate the sensing area maps, connectivity holes in data transfer with in upper hemispherical transmission range at appropriate time stamps. Simulation of the proposed protocol with aquasim patch in network simulator 2 captures the experimental condition analogous to underwater networks.

articleTitle: Effect of scaling on the performance of NEMS devices in switching applications
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This paper discusses the effect of technology scaling in the performance of electrical parameters of NEMS (Nano Electro Mechanical Switch) devices in switching applications. This has been done by modeling a typical Cantilever NEMS with fixed dimensions using Matlab simulation tool and then varying its beam parameters to characterize the effect on pull in voltage. The reference model of 65 nm technology provides a pull in voltage of 0.9 V. This paper examines the possibility of minimization of beam dimensions, simultaneous effects on electrical parameters of the beam and range of mechanical delay that can be afforded to improve the switching performance. Physical structure of Cantilever and Suspended NEMS have been created using Coventorware Simulation tool. Mathematical model ensures fast switching with technology scaling whereas Coventorware implementation proves the possibility of minimization of pull in without considering the ratio of dimensions.

articleTitle: Guiding System Reform and Innovation of Embedded Technology Development under the Background of Mathematical Modeling
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Guiding system reform and further innovation of embedded technology development under the background of the mathematical modeling is analyzed in the paper. In our research, we have the following novelties. (1) Industrial modularization is basis of the industrial integration, which refines the enterprise, organization and target object in the value chain into a subsystem that can then run independently. (2) System processing primary functions are no longer concentrated on the single core processor, but are shared by multiple processors based on functional classification to then from a single core to multiple cores. (3) The data mining and mathematical modelling are combined to then construct the efficient system. Based on the proposed model, we then propose the suggestions for the guiding system reform and further innovation.

articleTitle: Development of open-CV framework for minutiae Extraction and matching of fingerprints
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Fingerprint Recognition is a vital method in biometric identification and verification of human beings in various domains like Security, Digital Forensics, Internet of Things (loT), and many more. Each individual human is having distinct fingerprint pattern than others, hence it is one of the most prominent and widely used method to distinguish individuals. Many research studies and solutions have been developed in biometric domain since a decade, which influences now in making the process of fingerprint recognition more optimized, faster and efficient. However, present fingerprint acquisition/recognition systems have some limitations, mainly longer computation time for fingerprint matching and evaluating the results. This paper presents a procedure for fingerprint matching that takes into account minutiae features in finger print images and the process of creating an OpenCV structure for minutiae extraction and matching of fingerprints.

articleTitle: Progression of Smart Metering Infrastructure for Electric Vehicle Charging Stations
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This paper gives an idea about a smart metering infrastructure design and development of public charging stations to charge public electric vehicles. The need for charging point arises for electric vehicle charging process and escalate more use of electric vehicles. According to the user needs, some security systems installed in charging stations. This paper describes public charging point development with smart metering to guide the user, which can precisely monitor the transfer of electric energy when the problem occurs auto shutdowns, when charging is done to describe the level, stops the charging process which ensures saving of energy which can be further utilized. To measure the electrical energy while charging process, Kwh metre with accuracy up to 0.5 watts is used in the charging station. For data processing, a microprocessor is used which will show the data on the 15-inch screen for user information. S mart Card enables purchasing process to complete the charge cycle.

articleTitle: Intelligent Algorithms of Automatic text Formation Based on Knowledge Point Association Analysis and Fuzzy Clustering
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Intelligent algorithms for college automatic formation of English test paper based on the knowledge point association analysis and fuzzy clustering are designed in this manuscript. As a kind of evolutionary algorithm, differential evolutionary algorithm is based on real-number coding. The mathematical model of this paper mainly focuses on the three kinds of the operations of variation, crossover and selection. The biggest difference between differential evolutionary algorithm and genetic algorithm is that the variation operation in differential evolutionary algorithm is based on the difference vector of the chromosomes. Aiming at the risk that the association between data will be damaged due to the hard association rule processing of the traditional Boolean mining algorithms, fuzzy theory is introduced into the association rule mining model. The proposed method can achieve the test paper automatic formation based on the knowledge point association analysis. The performance is validated through the experimental analysis.

articleTitle: Analysis of Evolved Shape Dual-Band 2×1 Microstrip Patch Array Antenna on Different Substrate and Size
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: An evolved dual-band 2×1 Microstrip Patch Array Antennas are designed with rectangular slot defected ground structure. The proposed antennas are used with two different substrates FR4 and RT Duroid 5880 and third one is the same shape with the half size of substrate and shape of the proposed antenna ( A1 or A2). The dimensions of the proposed antennas (A1, A2) and A3 are taken as (50×40×1.6) mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> and (25×20×1.6) mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> respectively. The proposed antenna- A1 resonate at 3 GHz and 17 GHz with the corresponding peak gain 2.76 dBi and 5.55 dBi and impedance bandwidth of 42.14% & 24.71% respectively. The proposed antenna- A2 resonate at 4 GHz and 7 GHz with the corresponding peak gain 4.26 dBi and 5.52 dBi and impedance bandwidth of 30.77 % & 21.58% respectively. The proposed antenna- A3 resonate at 5 GHz and 10 GHz with the corresponding peak gain 1.05 dBi and 1.50 dBi and impedance bandwidth of 7.84% & 10.84 % respectively. The applicability of all three proposed antenna depends on their resonance frequency, they are useful for S, C, X, K and Ku-band and for next generation IOT devices and WLAN/Wi-Max for smart home applications. The designed has been simulated by HFSS v.13.0.

articleTitle: A Novel CPU based Architecture for an Integrated Optical Sensor
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel CPU based architecture for an integrated optical sensor used in smartphones. An integrated optical sensor consisting of an ambient light sensor and a proximity sensor is designed using the proposed CPU based architecture. The paper also compares the architectural and performance difference between an existing Finite State Machine (FSM) based optical sensor, and the proposed CPU based optical sensor. In the first phase of the research work, the existing FSM based optical sensor architecture is studied. The area, power consumption, hardware flexibility and performance of the FSM based architecture is analyzed. Then, CPU based architecture is defined. The ARM CORTEX M0+ processor is used as the CPU and the AMBA AHB-lite bus protocol is used to connect the processor to the peripherals. In the second phase of the research work, different digital blocks are designed and are interfaced with the processor. The proposed architecture is then synthesized and the experimental results are analyzed.

articleTitle: FPGA Controlled 3phase Voltage Source Inverter
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Due to the proportional increase of both the energy demand and human population, the energy management techniques require a significant research attention. One of the best ways for catering the energy crisis is through solar power / energy plants. The significant elements present in the solar powered system are solar modules, power inverter, control strategy and fed loads. FPGA is the efficient means for controlling the three phase voltage source inverter. This paper discusses about the hardware implementation of three phase voltage source inverter with the gating signals that are produced with the help of Spartan FPGA.

Author Keywords: Very high speed IC's hardware description language (VHDL)

articleTitle: Enhancement of Cloud Security Feature in OpenStack
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: OpenStack is an orchestration software that manages resources in the cloud platform. The cloud security is managed by a module named security groups in OpenStack. The OpenStack security groups feature has a few limitations, one of them being a static way for protecting the VM instances. The main objective of this paper is enhancing the OpenStack security groups feature. It provides a dynamic approach to restrict the access to VM instances from malicious hosts on the internet, which are obtained from Cisco Talos. These malicious IP addresses are stored in the binary search trees. Packet sniffing is used to obtain the IP addresses of the incoming packets and IP tables are used as firewalls to filter the incoming traffic and protect the VM instances.

articleTitle: Firmware Attack Detection on Gadgets Using Kohonen's Self Organizing Feature Maps (KSOFM)
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: According to the NIST International Security risk report, throughout the last several years, firmware exploits has almost quintupled. Public network wireless and community users can be particularly compromised, as the non-commercial users. However, conventional extremely pro-virus software, operating procedures and vulnerability device prototypes are not detectable for such firmware hacks. To avoid the high risk, companies among all sorts must, along with server and application security, render the safety of edge computer equipment and firmware AS their primary concern. The proposed Firmware Kohonen's Self Organizing Feature Maps (KSOFM) helps to describe such a firmware assault on gadgets. With the firmware KSOM and information from a non-regular source space, the model will choose a collection of better characteristics to approximate the intrinsic dissemination. The characteristic map represents changes in the source density figures: the reference area through which test learning segments are derived when compared to the bigger target fields and thus higher than the test area areas through which testing dimensions are derived with lower probabilities. The result shows that the truth positive rating is 98.28 percent, and that the adware attack is 0.02 percent positive.

articleTitle: Closed-Loop Frequency Control Buck PFC with Hybrid Capacitor with Boosted Power Factor
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Due to an increase in industrial and consumer needs, electronic equipment has gained a large interest. This equipment uses a large number of nonlinear loads that inject harmonics to the system and thereby distorting the supply current. Hence a tremendous need for APFC has arrived. A closed-loop variable frequency controlled interleaved buck PFC with a hybrid capacitor is introduced to diminish the conduction losses and switching stresses that occur in traditional PFCs. The converter control deals with the switching frequency rather than the duty cycle to achieve the aim. A 220V AC to 15V DC, 100W system is developed in Matlab to verify the thesis and the waveforms are obtained. The results confirm that THD has greatly decreased and hence the power factor correction is carried out.

articleTitle: Implementation of Hybrid Optimization for Improvement in Efficiency of Clustering Techniques
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In data tunneling and data analysis, clustering plays a vital role. Clustering is a technique wherein the resultant groups formed by including the similar data. Cluster analysis groups testimony based on correlation and diversity are observed among the data elements. These formed groups are called as clusters and it is also referred as an unsupervised approach. There are distinct algorithms that consider the data attributes and the crunch numbers to form clusters from the information. Based on the behavior of the algorithm, the centroids are preferred naturally by algorithm or the user can define it. The preferred algorithm for clustering is K-Means to split up the data based on the mark of compactness, but it also has some demerits like falling in local optimum. So, in order to avoid, that another algorithm used here is fuzzy clustering algorithm (FCM). FCM also has another face which describe that the Euclidean distance measures can consider unevenly weight underlying factors. Getting uplifted from the decorum of birds, particle swarm optimization (PSO) is a worldwide enhancement process. PSO is popularly used in many cluster analysis issues. So, in order to make algorithm gives better results, two algorithms are brought together to take advantage of twain design. This works set forth the hybrid combination of K-means and PSO called as Hybrid-PSO. The primary responsibility for linking two algorithms is that it gives preferable results in terms of speed and proves to be a strong clustering algorithm, which will be shell out for fitter optimization.

articleTitle: Prediction of Parkinson's disease using Local Ternary Pattern for Gait Signals
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is one of the common neurodegenerative diseases. The severity of the disease increases with age. The primary reason for Parkinson's disease is the deterioration of dopamine-producing brain cells in substantia. The cardinal symptoms of PD comprise of bradykinesia, tremor and rigidness which can be detected by the gait movements. In this study, the pattern recognition technique was utilized for feature extraction and classification using ANN showed virtuous accurateness when LTP technique was used. Eight statistical features were taken for the classification. The performance parameters such as accuracy, sensitivity, specificity and F1 score achieved for the lower bound are 97.02%, 96.55%, 99.57%, 97.09 % respectively.

articleTitle: Design and Prototype Development of a SelfBalancing mechanism Using Gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Self-balancing bicycle using gyroscope finds its attention in the deal with of street safety. The progress of a system to compare a bicycle irrespective of its gesture deserves momentous importance. Gyroscopes come across its effort stabilizing systems of innumerable systems such as stabilizers in dispatch and journey rule of aircraft. The amalgamation of gyroscopes for the self- balancing of bicycles is existing in this paper. A self- balancing bicycle develop is deliberate by incorporating a gyroscope consisting of a flywheel. Floorboard, battery, put on the right track present motors, helm and posture government and a voltage say unit. A two-dimensional sketch of the replica was arranged and comprehensive to motif a three-dimensional pattern by sketch up and constant edge. To make available a lucrative and professional design, a parquet completed of plywood as a substitute of other metals as covert is selected as it is a outshine absorber of atmosphere and shocks. The gimbal set up is bolted to the strip and the flywheel is fond of to the structure. The industrial prototype experienced for self-balancing and which proves the integration of the gyroscope in the bicycle in self-balancing the phase at what time it is subjected to a tilt.

Author Keywords: Two Wheeler Self Balancing With Gyroscope

articleTitle: Managing & Detecting Fishy Nodes in MANET using Cloud Concepts
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Nodes in mobile adhoc network (MANET) can self-configure itself. They may behave differently due to its openness in structure and different energy levels. Connectivity part in MANET provides communication interface, which can be used by all kinds of users. This may cause Fishy conditions among the networks with threats. To find a single node among the vast amount of network is impossible. So, a better storage and resource management procedure may fix the above mentioned problem. Cloud storage provides best allocations for the nodes with high data storage and security. The Resource management among the Cloud environment provides better communication among the networks. These operations in MANET neither depend on preexistent base stations or other infrastructures. The firefly algorithm innate the flashing behaviour of fire fly. These files use varying intensity light patterns for searching its prey and finding its mates. Their attractiveness commensurate with the light intensity. The existing method provided distributed communication among the networks. By enabling the client and server communication as well as in the normal networks fishy nodes among the networks can be found easily. The connection provides a peer to peer communication among the networks so that communication gets stronger and easy to triangulate fishy nodes among the networks. Data and Resource maintenance done from the server location for avoiding data loss and other kinds of threats among the network. The proposed method provides a best way of communication among the networks.

articleTitle: A Compelling Pattern Reconfigurable Antenna without Utilizing Exchanging Innovation
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: An effective pattern reconfigurable antenna is proposed using CST-MW simulator. Essentially, the proposed antenna is a unique sort of antenna and ready to make inclusion at two headings by utilizing a couple of waveguide port without utilizing any switching technology. This antenna can reconfigure the pattern automatically. The proposed antenna can switch the beam one direction to its 180° reverse angle. Therefore, it may have called a smart antenna that has high pattern directivity. It provides about 460 MHz bandwidth at 2.4 GHz that is ideal for Wi-Fi frameworks and would be enhanced the speed. Furthermore, its compactness and provides small VSWR value to make this antenna effective for Wi-Fi systems. Consequently, this antenna could be adopted for the base station design for Wi-Fi technology.

articleTitle: Review of Ubiquitous Computing Based on Markov Chain and High Complexity Data Streaming Model
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Review of tourism informationization based on the Markov Chain and the high complexity data streaming model is studied in this manuscript. Most of the recommendation systems are poor in scalability due to their own defects. Although some optimization strategies have been adopted to improve them, most of them are further optimized and mainly run on a single server. Hence, this paper has some modifications. First, the choice of cache node location can be attributed to the resource allocation problem, which is also focus of research in doud environment, we construct the efficient data center for preparing. Second, the grid resource discovery method must be able to adapt to the grid environment circle with characteristics of some large scale, heterogeneity, distribution, dynamic, openness and so on. We find the optimal model to avoid the time delay. The experiment results compared with the latest methods have been presented.

articleTitle: Adaptive Enhancement algorithm using image Decomposition for non-uniform illuminated images
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The objectivity of illumination and reflectance has been the continuous thrust area in image analysis and enhancement. To achieve better quality, the researchers have focused on improving contrast enhancement and brightness preservation of mainly non- uniform images. This paper reviews the computational techniques evolved for improving the visual quality of images. The discussion has been focused on multi-scale decomposition approach to achieve the desired variation in contrast and brightness of the images. The multi-scale approach is termed as a combination of coarse and detail coefficients of the input image. So, it may be said that the detail characteristics are evaluated to study directional variations of the intensity in the images.

articleTitle: An effective image transmission with DWT over fading channel
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: As the communication technologies are evolving significantly in wireless medium, this work aims to transmit and receive images with reduced bit error rate and increased peak signal to noise ratio. In this work, binary phase shift keying scheme is used to work in two phases to reduce the bit error rate. Along with binary phase shift keying, wavelet type transform, Symlet wavelet transform is also used to afford and analyze the image in both domains (time and frequency). The most advantageous part is the image with less noise can be improvised as a series of images or to video transmission hence can really take the transmission of information to next level. The advantage of the proposed work is shown in line with the existing works. The proposed work utilizes MATLAB wavelet tool box for achieving an efficient computation.

articleTitle: SiSbDp - The Technique to Identify Forgery in Legal Handwritten Documents
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Forgery is a fraudulent act if not detected it leads to serious repercussions. Documents that can be the object of forgery include contracts, bank cheques, identification cards, legal certificates, insurance claims, bills, wills, etc. Alterations in such documents by either addition of words or modification of the existing words can change its judicial value. Such alteration is made with the intention of gaining profit or incurring wrongful loss upon others. Analysis of ink represents an important area in forensic science to identify possible falsification and changes in documents. Various techniques are employed to identify fraudulent alteration in handwritten legal documents based on similar color ink analysis is presented in this research paper. This paper proposes a non-destructive approach S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</inf>S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b</inf>D<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</inf> for the identification of forgery in the legal handwritten documents.

articleTitle: Information Communication Guiding Model of Online Social Education of Rural Children in Chongqing Based on Data Dynamics and Mining
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Information communication guiding model of the online social education of rural children in Chongqing based on data dynamics and mining is designed in this manuscript. At present, the dynamic evolution methods of distributed software systems implemented from the perspective of the model-driven, control engineering, software architecture, etc. Hence, this paper has the 2 aspects of novelties. (1) Users of social networks have their own attitudes towards various types of messages, that is, they tend to spread the positive or negative degree of the message. (2) Dijkstra algorithm based on the shortest path of the static graph is modified to enable it to calculate the minimum delay path. The experimental results have proven the performance. In the future, we will apply the proposed method into more places.

articleTitle: Arduino based Smart Equipment for Pain Free Jaw Movement
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Trismus and Oral submucous fibrosis (OSMF) is a frequently observed clinical condition. Rehabilitation with mouth-opening exercises is very much essential for a fast and successful recovery. To deal with these conditions, smart equipment for pain-free jaw movement has been modelled and clinically tested. In the proposed Trismus treatment equipment unit, the autonomous actions are attained by employing Arduino UNO as the core. Initially, the microcontroller will activate the pump to spray the mouth cleaner by prompting the relay interfaced to it. Upon activation, the pump will spray the mouth cleaner into the patient's mouth. After completion of mouth cleaner spraying, the microcontroller will activate the syringe to spray the pain reliever. The sprayed out medicine from the mouth is sucked out using the vacuum pump interfaced to the controller. Only after the completion, of mouth cleaner and pain reliever spraying and also syringe for intralession fibrolytics gets activated after which the action of mouth opening mechanism unit is initiated. The level of mouth opening threshold and the number of times the task needs to be repeated can be set by the user by triggering the control input switches interfaced to the controller. After the input triggered by the control switch, the controller automatically does the mouth opening exercises. In such a way, automation in forceful mouth opening for the treatment of OSMF is attained in the proposed system.

articleTitle: The $\mathrm{g}_{\mathrm{m}}/\mathrm{I}_{\mathrm{d}}$ Methodology based Design and Optimization of Analog Circuits
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This paper aims to design different analog circuits by utilizing the g<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub>/I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d</sub> based methodology, which helps to find the distortion in parameters of the circuits from that of the desired parameters. The initial phase focuses on the design of different circuits and the second phase of the experiment is optimization of the mismatch in the circuit parameters designed in the first part. The simulation of the circuits are performed using Cadence Virtuoso design suite. The complete design procedure including optimization was automated using MATLAB R2018a.

articleTitle: Underwater Image Restoration using Scene Depth Estimation Technique
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Underwater image restoration is a difficult task due to the shortage of reference image and changing underwater environment. The images are distorted by absorption and scattering eff ect of light. In deep water, light undergoes wavelength-dependent attenuation. Thus, red color light that has a large wavelength attenuates more than blue light and any other color. As depth increases, light attenuates most of the red content and image appears in bluish-green color. These images also have low contrast, color cast and hazy appearance. Existing methods may need specialized hardware or it may be based on multiple images of the same scene. Thus they cannot be used in real-time or video acquisition task. So, it's better to form an effective method for color enhancement and image restoration of images. Here depth map estimation along with image blurriness is proposed. As light travels deeper into the water, the image gets blurred and this is used to obtain depth map. The backlight is also obtained. These factors are substituted in the IFM (Image Formation Model) to restore the image.

articleTitle: Modified Fractional Frequency Reuse Scheme for Non-orthogonal Multiple Access Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The node density and mobile data traffic demand are increased with the advent of the internet of things (IoT) and telecommunication operators that have started deploying 5G cellular networks in order to get over the restriction imposed by the existing 4G cellular network. Besides microcellular base stations, inexpensive and simple radio heads are installed on a vast scale to support femto-cellular structure. This massive deployment of femto-cellular access points requires frequency reuse in each cell to raise the concern of inter-cell interference (ICI). This paper presents the modified fractional frequency reuse (MFFR) scheme for non-orthogonal multiple access multi cellular networks to mitigate the ICI by creating various sectoral patterns inside each cell. The performance evaluation illustrates the proposed MFFR outperforms the state-of-the-art.

articleTitle: An automatic assessment of histogram mode on X-radiography weld image using non-maxima suppression
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: An assessment and understanding of image properties is the key task in the digital image processing field. Among image processing techniques, segmentation of the low illumination image is a more typical and important problem besides the selection of histogram-based segmentation technique also challenging task. Particularly, weld defect X-radiography images are generally in low-contrast, and the defects have appeared on the larger background area of the image. Further, the mode of the histogram performs an important component in the histogram-based segmentation techniques and many techniques are categorized based on histogram mode, such as unimodal, bimodal, and multimodal. Therefore, it is a necessary task to prior assessment of histogram mode of the image, which leads to select the appropriate segmentation technique and without any inappropriate attempt. A new approach is proposed to automatically assess the histogram mode of the image using the non-maxima suppression technique. The proposed method is implemented on the X-radiography weld image dataset and the accuracy of the assessment provides satisfactory.

articleTitle: Implementation of a Novel Data Sharing Scheme Amongst Dynamic Group Users in Cloud
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Centered on its inherent data sharing and low latency features, cloud infrastructure is considered as an effective alternative to conventional information technology. Cloud service providers (CSPs) like Amazon, are capable of providing cloud users with various services by integrating the powerful data centers. Users may utilize high-quality software to move their local data processing systems to cloud storage and save considerable investments in their local infrastructures. Annotation techniques by utilizing the pairs of meaning attributes are usually more descriptive, as they provide more details than the untyped methods. A new solution to use more concise queries with such annotations is the “pay-as-you-go” querying technique in data spaces.

articleTitle: Design and development of arduino based multipurpose wheelchair for disabled patients
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In this fast-developing world, the field of science and technology shows a significant improvement in enhancing the living standard of humans. Even though technology augments the living standards, people with physical disabilities, find it difficult to cope up with the fast-paced world. By statistical assessment, 10% of world population suffers from physical disabilities which obligate them to be dependent on wheelchairs with external support. Thus, the main aim of this proposed research work is to develop a wheelchair which is both effective and user friendly. The proposed model includes features that make it comfortable and convenient for the patients. An Arduino UNO is used as microcontroller board. Two DC motors are used to run the wheelchair with the help of a thumb-controlled Joystick. A digital accelerometer is used to recline the wheelchair into a gurney. For detection of any obstacles, an ultrasonic sensor is used. A seat belt is also endowed for safety. Working of the wheelchair is examined and the effective output is obtained.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Deep Learning based Super-Resolution Techniques for Thermal Videos
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Video streams acquired from thermal cameras are proven to be beneficial in diverse number of fields including military, healthcare, law enforcement, and security. Despite the hype, thermal imaging is increasingly affected by poor resolution, where it has expensive optical sensors and inability to attain optical precision. In recent years, deep learning based super-resolution algorithms are developed to enhance the video frame resolution at high accuracy. This paper presents a comparative analysis of super resolution (SR) techniques based on deep neural networks (DNN) that are applied on thermal video dataset. SRCNN, EDSR, Auto-encoder, and SRGAN are also discussed and investigated. Further the results on benchmark thermal datasets including FLIR, OSU thermal pedestrian database and OSU color thermal database are evaluated and analyzed. Based on the experimental results, it is concluded that, SRGAN has delivered a superior performance on thermal frames when compared to other techniques and improvements, which has the ability to provide state-of-the art performance in real time operations.

articleTitle: Analyzing the effectiveness of metamorphosing images using color maps
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Ensuring the image privacy, storing, and securely retaining them is a challenge in the present world. In this work, a method for metamorphosing the image is studied. For these images from the dataset METUSURV used for studying the pseudo coloring method for implementing image privacy and obtaining the real picture from this disguised image [1]. The pseudo coloring performed with different color maps and motion blurring. The effectiveness of color maps producing disguised images is analyzed and selected best result producing maps for creating a disguised image. Joint photographic expert group (JPEG) compression, Zlib compression, advanced encryption standard (AES) are incorporated in this proposed research work. The quality of the retained image is measured using SSIM and PSNR. The characteristics of the method are examined and used with other privacy ensuring methods. This extended study shows the quality and effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: River Mapping using Ultrasonic and Flow Meter Sensors
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This work aims to de velop a simple and low-cost method to determine the flow happening across a river which is used to determine the feasibility of a small-scale hydroelectric project. Measurement of parameters like depth of river and flow velocity of water are done with the help of a drone. A turbine flow meter is used to measure flow velocity and an ultrasonic sensor is used for depth measurement and are attached to the drone using an aluminium shaft. The instruments are carefully selected based on their capacity and output range. They are tested in artificial environments to check the reliability and effectiveness and are calibrated to work in the real-world environments. The sensors are attached to the drone using special mounting structures. Drone transports the sensors to pre-identified sites, which are mostly difficult to reach humans to take measurements. The readings are transferred wirelessly to a mobile phone. Further, the calculations and analysis are performed based on river parameters. This method allows economical and eco-friendly measurement of depth and flow velocity remotely in difficult terrains and locations that remain inaccessible to man.

articleTitle: FSR Sensor based Embedded system to detect imbalance in Autistic children
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Autism Spectrum Disorder is a serious developmental disorder that impairs the ability to communicate and interact. It impacts the nervous system and affects the overall cognitive, emotional, social and physical health of the affected individual. There is a lack of evidence-based estimate of the population prevalence of ASD in India but according to certain statistics, there is a prevalence of about 0.23% of the total population. Autism causes postural difficulties in patients due to which, it isn't possible for them to balance properly. This is a very serious issue that comes with autism. Not being able to maintain a proper posture and being unable to balance oneself properly makes day-to-day activities extremely difficult. The main aim of the study is to design and develop a portable and easy-to-use pressure mat to detect imbalance in autistic children and To measure the pressure applied by different points under the foot and to analyze the improvement of posture balancing abilities of autistic children. The results suggest that the pressure reference to the autistic patient foot is different from normal and there is no stability in the measurements.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of New Family of Modified Hybrid ZSB DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This paper presents a performance analysis of a new family of modified hybrid ZSB dc-dc converter. The output voltage of PV panels is very low therefore a high boost stage is often required. Conventional Z-source converter (ZSC) suffers from some limitations on boosting voltage so a new family of modified hybrid ZSB dc-dc converter is proposed. Different hybrid ZSCs are used to design a new family of modified hybrid ZSB DC-DC converter. In proposed converters, an additional switch and a diode is connected at the output terminal of traditional hybrid ZSCs, adds the benefit to gain. In contrast to the hybrid Z-source topologies, the high boost factor is realized with a small duty cycle . It is observed that modified converters have high voltage gain about twice of their respective hybrid ZS boost converters. The performance of the proposed converters is compared with traditional Z-source converters and traditional hybrid Z-source boost converters. All results are validated by using MATLAB/SIMULINK R2016a.

articleTitle: Design of Single-Band Rectifier with Self-Tuning Impedance Matching Circuit
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In this paper, a wide input power range rectifier with Self Tuning Impedance Matching (STIM) is proposed. STIM contains a capacitor, which is charged by the output voltage of the rectifier at low input conditions. STIM is used to reduce the inductive nature of the input impedance Zin at low input power. The frequency of the single band rectifier is 0.9GHz. Power conversion efficiency is maintained as 50% from -1dBm to 18dBm in the case of rectifier with STIM. In case of rectifier without STIM power conversion efficiency is 50% from 0dBm to 15dBm.

articleTitle: Phishing Attacks Detection using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Evolving digital transformation has exacerbated cybersecurity threats globally. Digitization expands the doors wider to cybercriminals. Initially cyberthreats approach in the form of phishing to steal the confidential user credentials. Usually, Hackers will influence the users through phishing in order to gain access to the organizatlou's digital assets and networks. With security breaches, cybercriminals execute ransomware attack, get unauthorized access, and shut down systems and even demand a ransom for releasing the access. Anti-phishing software and techniques are circumvented by the phishers for dodging tactics. Though threat intelligence and behavioural analytics systems support organizations to spot the unusual traffic patterns, still the best practice to prevent phishing attacks is defended in depth. In this perspective, the proposed research work has developed a model to detect the phishing attacks using machine learning (ML) algorithms like random forest (RF) and decision tree (DT). A standard legitimate dataset of phishing attacks from Kaggle was aided for ML processing. To analyze the attributes of the dataset, the proposed model has used feature selection algorithms like principal component analysis (PCA). Finally, a maximum accuracy of 97% was achieved through the random forest algorithm.

articleTitle: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) in Disaster Management Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Keeping a track of disasters is very important to alleviate their effects, destruction caused on the environment and human population, this can be eased by employing unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV), furnished with cameras that yield photos of the areas of interest. Fleeting growth in the field of unmanned aerial vehicles in distinctive fields has pushed towards exploring possible benefits by deploying them in disaster management. UAVs helps in setting up communication network between victims, survivors and designated rescue team. This paper highlights the communication technologies that can give rise to UAV disaster management systems including early warning system, emergency communication, and image processing, and presents our preliminary work to demonstrate the benefits of UAV systems.

articleTitle: Phishing Attacks Detection using Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2020 Third International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In the COVID-19 pandemic, people are enforced to adopt ‘work from home’ policy. The Internet has become an effective channel for social interactions nowadays. Peoples' immense dependence on digital platform opens doors for fraud. Phishing is a type of cybercrime to steal users' credentials from online platforms such as online banking, online business, e-commerce, online classroom, digital marketplaces, etc. Phishers develop fake webpages alike the original one and send spam emails to hook the users. Phishers seize users' credentials when an online user visits the counterfeit webpages through the spams.
